title: Four Off-duty Coast Guardsmen Save Man's Life in Amityville, New York (2nd Version)
description: Four U.S. Coast Guardsmen from U.S. Coast Guard Station Eaton's Neck saved a man's life near Gilgo Island, New York, July 1, 2026. The four members were off-duty near the beach when they saw a man in distress. The crew discovered the man had life-threatening injuries after he was ejected from his vessel. Utilizing their small boat training and quick thinking, they were able to rescue the man and give him over to higher care. The mayor of Amityville, New York, recognized the members and they were able to catch up with the man whose life they rescued. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Rajesh Harrilal) (This version of the video included a slide at the beginning with additional context to the story.)
keywords: life-saving action, off-duty actions, U.S. Coast Guard Sector Long Island Sound, U.S. Coast Guard Station Eaton's Neck
